cards.text: The word of the LORD comes to the prophet Ezekiel, and this time it's about the Ammonites, the descendants of Abraham's nephew Lot (Deuteronomy 2:19; Genesis 12:5). God says, 'Son of man, set your face against the Ammonites and prophesy against them.' That's not a glance, friend, that's the FULL stare-down.

cards.question: God gives the Ammonites a reason. It's about how they reacted when His sanctuary was profaned, Israel's land was laid waste and Judah went into exile. What did the Ammonites do?

cards.text: So God will give the Ammonites to the people of the East, who will pitch their tents among them and eat their fruit and drink their milk. Cheer at your neighbor's bad day, and SUDDENLY there are strangers camping in YOUR yard.

cards.question: God says Ammon will become a resting place for sheep. And the Ammonite city of Rabbah? God says it will become a pasture for which animal?
True or false: God says that when all this happens to them, the Ammonites will know that He is the LORD.

cards.text: Then God gives a second reason: the Ammonites clapped their hands and stomped their feet over the land of Israel. Clapping AND stomping isn't a reaction, friend, that's a halftime show.

cards.question: God says the Ammonites rejoiced over the land of Israel with a heart full of ___.

cards.text: So God will stretch out His hand against the Ammonites and give them as plunder to the nations.

cards.question: True or false: God says the Ammonites will keep their place among the peoples.

cards.text: Next up is Moab, another people descended from Lot (Genesis 19:36-37), and with it Seir, the land where Esau settled (Genesis 36:8). This time, God brings up something they said.

cards.question: God brings up something Moab and Seir said about the house of Judah. What was it?

answers.text: Judah is like all the other nations
Judah will soon rise up again
Judah is greater than every nation

cards.text: So God will expose the flank of Moab, beginning with its frontier cities, the glory of the land: Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon and Kiriathaim. He names them one by one, friend, like a roll call nobody wanted to be on.

cards.question: God says He'll give Moab, along with the Ammonites, to the people of the East. What does He say will happen to the Ammonites among the nations?

answers.text: They will no longer be remembered
They will be honored once again
They will rule over the nations

cards.text: So God will execute judgments on Moab, and they will know that He is the LORD. I picture Moab shrugging when it called Judah just like everybody else, and friend, that shrug got EXPENSIVE.
Now God turns to Edom, the nation that came from Esau (Genesis 36:9). God says Edom acted vengefully against the house of Judah.

cards.question: True or false: God says that by acting vengefully against Judah, Edom incurred grievous guilt.

cards.text: God says He'll stretch out His hand against Edom and cut off both man and beast. He'll make it a wasteland, and from Teman to Dedan they will fall by the sword.

cards.question: God says He'll take His vengeance on Edom. Whose hand will He use to do it?
True or false: God says Israel will deal with Edom according to Israel's own anger.

cards.text: Last come the Philistines. Yes, friend, the same people Goliath came out to fight for (1 Samuel 17:4).

cards.question: God says the Philistines took vengeance with malice of soul, trying to destroy Judah with ___ hostility.

cards.text: So God says, 'Behold, I will stretch out My hand against the Philistines…' He'll destroy the remnant along the coast, and there's one more name on that list.

cards.question: Along with destroying the Philistine remnant along the coast, who does God say He'll cut off?
True or false: God says He will execute great vengeance against the Philistines with furious reproof.

cards.text: Then they will know that He is the LORD, when He lays His vengeance upon them. And that's the last name on God's list, friend.
